specs_seen: Supported: single mainboard with STM32F103RCT6/RET6 or GD32F103RCT6. NOT supported: Artery AT32F403RCT6 / AT32F413RCT7 ('the cheapest and more common ones available on Aliexpress now'); split boards (STM32F130C8T6, GD32F130C8T6, MM32SPIN05/06/25) need other forks. 6-wire hall variant needs BOARD_VARIANT change in config.h. README links cloidnerux/hoverboard-firmware-hack for AT32F403RCT6.
note: Identify by opening the shell: one central mainboard + 2 sideboards = candidate (then read MCU marking); two motor boards (one per wheel) = split board = not EFeru (RoboDurden Hoverboard-Firmware-Hack-Gen2.x instead).
